name: ARMAR-6
summary: A collaborative humanoid from KIT's high-performance humanoid technologies lab, with two torque-controlled 8-DOF arms on a mobile base, built to help human workers maintain industrial equipment. ARMAR-6 recognises when a person needs help, hands over tools, holds parts and holds a spoken dialogue, continuing KIT's decades-long ARMAR series.
notable: Proactively offers help based on recognised human activity
Latest in KIT's long-running ARMAR humanoid line
